BMS-3768

Internal Transfer Alerts

Review Story Priority: TBD bk build crawl fast-trackable gulf phase-1-crawl polished roadmap-v2-baseline wms
github.com/Ohanafy/OHFY-Split/pull/503 →
Context Narrative Diffs

Ticket Context

As a Gulf Warehouse Manager, I want internal Transfer Alerts, so that receiving warehouse teams are immediately notified when inbound internal transfers contain close-to-code or high-priority product — enabling them to prioritize dock processing and avoid accepting inventory that will expire before it can be sold through their routes.

Gulf currently has no structured way to communicate transfer urgency between warehouses — close-to-code product arrives unannounced, discovered only at check-in, leading to write-off disputes and wasted labor.

Acceptance Criteria (Gherkin)

Scenario: Close-to-code transfer triggers alert to receiving warehouse Given an internal transfer from Montgomery AL to Huntsville AL contains SKUs within the alert threshold When the transfer is saved with Status = 'Submitted' Then a Transfer_Alert__c is created (item, qty, code date, days remaining, sending warehouse) And a platform notification reaches Huntsville AL Warehouse Receiving users And the transfer header shows a "Close to Code — X days remaining" badge
Scenario: Hot transfer flagged manually by sending warehouse Given a manager toggles 'Hot Transfer' + priority reason on an outbound transfer Then a Transfer_Alert__c (Alert_Type__c = 'Hot Transfer') is created And receiving users get a notification with the reason + expected arrival And the transfer shows a red priority indicator, sorted above non-hot transfers
Scenario: Receiving team acknowledges transfer alert When the receiving lead clicks 'Acknowledge' on an alert Then status moves Pending -> Acknowledged with user + timestamp And unacknowledged alerts past the escalation window show an 'Overdue' badge
Scenario: Transfer contains mix of close-to-code and normal product Given 3 of 12 line items are close-to-code Then only those 3 are flagged; header reads 'Partial Close to Code — 3 of 12 items'
Scenario: Alert threshold is configurable per warehouse or brand Given Brand X has a 21-day threshold vs. the 14-day standard Then each SKU is evaluated against its applicable threshold, not a single global value

What Was Built

Dispatching a Transfer Group (New → In Progress) now evaluates every line for close-to-code risk against the receiving warehouse's existing CTC_Threshold__mdt band — reusing the established close-to-code engine rather than introducing a new config surface, and resolving the ticket's open question about per-entity (FL/AL) thresholds via per-warehouse CMDT rows. Flagged lines publish a Transfer_Alert_Event__e platform event (mirroring the existing Negative_Inv_Incident_Event__e pattern), which a subscriber idempotently upserts into a queryable Transfer_Alert__c and fires a custom notification for. A parallel manual path lets a sending manager flag a transfer "Hot" with a priority reason. Two new LWCs — a record-page banner and a warehouse-level inbound queue — surface both alert types with acknowledge/overdue handling, and the PR went through two rounds of /code-review fixes (namespace, DTO/ADR-0007 split, redelivery correctness, mobile layout, coverage) before landing at 76/76 Apex tests green.

Key Decisions

  1. Reused the existing close-to-code engine instead of a new threshold. CTC_Threshold__mdt + S_CTCSuggestionEngine already modeled per-warehouse code-date tolerance; S_TransferAlerts resolves against the receiving warehouse's row, which also answers the ticket's "per-entity FL/AL window" open question without a schema change.
  2. FEFO lot selection at origin. Days-to-code is computed from the soonest-expiring sellable lot of the line's item at the origin location — the lot actually most at risk — not just any lot.
  3. Platform-event decoupling with idempotent upsert. Alert detection (in the dispatch transaction) is separated from alert materialization (subscriber trigger) via Transfer_Alert_Event__e + PublishAfterCommit. The subscriber upserts on External_Id__c = 'transfer-alert:<transferId>:<lotId>' so platform-event redelivery can never create a duplicate alert.
  4. DTO/factory split per ADR-0007. A code-review finding moved fromSObject() out of the global, LWC-facing TransferAlertDTO into a sibling @namespaceAccessible TransferAlert factory — global classes carry data, not business logic.
  5. Notification failures are swallowed; upsert failures are not. TransferAlertEventHandler lets a notification-send failure pass silently so it never blocks the platform-event's retry-safe upsert — but an upsert failure still propagates so redelivery can retry.
  6. Custom permission over hardcoded permission set for notification targeting. WMS_Transfer_Alert_Receiver custom permission decouples "who gets notified" from a single fixed permission set assignment.

Open Items

Banner's wiredAlerts shows the same empty state on a wire error as on genuinely no data — no visual distinction. Explicitly accepted as v1-acceptable per the code-review round, tracked for later.
PILL_BASE / daysToCodeLabel are duplicated between transferAlertBanner and transferAlertQueue — low risk today, flagged as a good extraction candidate if a third alert surface appears.
Ticket's open question ("per-entity FL/AL windows — no Entity__c field for it") was resolved as a product/data decision (per-warehouse CTC_Threshold__mdt rows) rather than a schema change — worth confirming this still matches product intent since it was called out as a genuinely open question in the ticket.

5+    <deprecated>false</deprecated>


6+    <description>

10+        Transfer Group advances New -&gt; In Progress and the shipping lot falls within the

1+import { LightningElement, api, track, wire } from "lwc";


2+import { loadStyle } from "lightning/platformResourceLoader";


3+import { ShowToastEvent } from "lightning/platformShowToastEvent";


4+import formFactor from "@salesforce/client/formFactor";


5+import tailwindCSS from "@salesforce/resourceUrl/tailwindCSS_wms";


6+import getTransferAlerts from "@salesforce/apex/WMS_UI_Wrappers.getTransferAlerts";


7+import acknowledgeTransferAlert from "@salesforce/apex/WMS_UI_Wrappers.acknowledgeTransferAlert";


8+import { refreshApex } from "@salesforce/apex";


9+


10+const BAND_STYLES = {


11+    Critical:


12+        "background: rgb(var(--ohfy-danger, 163 45 45)); color: rgb(var(--ohfy-surface, 255 255 255));",


13+    Act: "background: rgb(var(--ohfy-accent, 228 242 35)); color: rgb(var(--ohfy-primary, 0 0 0));",


14+    Monitor:


15+        "background: rgb(var(--ohfy-surface-muted, 244 242 240)); color: rgb(var(--ohfy-text-muted, 84 84 84));",


16+};


17+const BAND_HEADER = {


18+    Critical: "background: rgb(var(--ohfy-danger, 163 45 45) / 0.08);",


19+    Act: "background: rgb(var(--ohfy-accent, 228 242 35) / 0.2);",


20+    Monitor: "",


21+};


22+const HOT_HEADER = "background: rgb(var(--ohfy-danger, 163 45 45) / 0.08);";


23+const PILL_BASE =


24+    "display: inline-block; font-size: 0.6rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04rem; padding: 0.1rem 0.45rem; border-radius: 0.75rem;";


25+


26+export default class TransferAlertBanner extends LightningElement {


27+    @api recordId;


28+


29+    @track _alerts = [];


30+    @track _acknowledging = new Set();


31+    @track isLoading = true;


32+    _wiredResult;


33+


34+    get isMobile() {


35+        return formFactor === "Small";


36+    }


37+


38+    connectedCallback() {


39+        Promise.all([loadStyle(this, tailwindCSS)]);


40+    }


41+


42+    @wire(getTransferAlerts, { transferGroupId: "$recordId" })


43+    wiredAlerts(result) {


44+        this._wiredResult = result;


45+        if (result.data !== undefined || result.error) {


46+            this.isLoading = false;


47+            this._alerts = result.data || [];


48+        }


49+    }


50+


51+    get isEmpty() {


52+        return !this.isLoading && (!this._alerts || this._alerts.length === 0);


53+    }


54+


55+    get enrichedAlerts() {


56+        return this._alerts.map(a => {


57+            const isHot = a.alertType === "Hot Transfer";


58+            const isAcknowledged = a.status === "Acknowledged";


59+            const band = a.urgencyBand || "Monitor";


60+


61+            const headerStyle = isHot ? HOT_HEADER : BAND_HEADER[band] || "";


62+


63+            const typePillStyle =


64+                PILL_BASE +


65+                (isHot


66+                    ? " background: rgb(var(--ohfy-danger, 163 45 45)); color: rgb(var(--ohfy-surface, 255 255 255));"


67+                    : " background: rgb(var(--ohfy-surface-muted, 244 242 240)); color: rgb(var(--ohfy-text-muted, 84 84 84));");


68+


69+            const bandPillStyle = PILL_BASE + " " + (BAND_STYLES[band] || BAND_STYLES.Monitor);


70+


71+            let daysToCodeLabel = null;


72+            if (!isHot && a.daysToCode != null) {


73+                const d = a.daysToCode;


74+                daysToCodeLabel = d < 0 ? `${Math.abs(d)} day(s) past code` : `${d} day(s) to code`;


75+            }


76+


77+            let acknowledgedAtFormatted = null;


78+            if (a.acknowledgedAt) {


79+                acknowledgedAtFormatted = new Date(a.acknowledgedAt).toLocaleString();


80+            }


81+


82+            return {


83+                ...a,


84+                isHot,


85+                isAcknowledged,


86+                showBand: !isHot && !!a.urgencyBand,


87+                headerStyle,


88+                typePillStyle,


89+                bandPillStyle,


90+                daysToCodeLabel,


91+                showDaysToCode: !!daysToCodeLabel,


92+                isAcknowledging: this._acknowledging.has(a.recordId),


93+                acknowledgedAtFormatted,


94+            };


95+        });


96+    }


97+


98+    get showPartialLabel() {


99+        if (this._alerts.length === 0) return false;


100+        const ctcAlerts = this._alerts.filter(a => a.alertType === "Close to Code");


101+        if (ctcAlerts.length === 0) return false;


102+        const ctcItemCount = new Set(ctcAlerts.map(a => a.itemId).filter(Boolean)).size;


103+        const total = this._alerts[0].totalTransferLineCount;


104+        if (total != null) {


105+            return ctcItemCount < total;


106+        }


107+        // Fallback when count is unavailable: partial if not all alerted items are CTC


108+        return ctcItemCount < new Set(this._alerts.map(a => a.itemId).filter(Boolean)).size;


109+    }


110+


111+    get alertedItemCount() {


112+        return new Set(


113+            this._alerts


114+                .filter(a => a.alertType === "Close to Code")


115+                .map(a => a.itemId)


116+                .filter(Boolean)


117+        ).size;


118+    }


119+


120+    get totalLineCount() {


121+        const total = this._alerts.length > 0 ? this._alerts[0].totalTransferLineCount : null;


122+        return total != null


123+            ? total


124+            : new Set(this._alerts.map(a => a.itemId).filter(Boolean)).size;


125+    }


126+


127+    async handleAcknowledge(event) {


128+        const alertId = event.currentTarget.dataset.id;


129+        if (!alertId || this._acknowledging.has(alertId)) return;


130+


131+        this._acknowledging = new Set([...this._acknowledging, alertId]);


132+        try {


133+            await acknowledgeTransferAlert({ alertId });


134+            await refreshApex(this._wiredResult).catch(() => {});


135+        } catch (e) {


136+            this.dispatchEvent(


137+                new ShowToastEvent({


138+                    title: "Error",


139+                    message: "Failed to acknowledge alert. Please try again.",


140+                    variant: "error",


141+                })


142+            );


143+        } finally {


144+            const next = new Set(this._acknowledging);


145+            next.delete(alertId);


146+            this._acknowledging = next;


147+        }


148+    }


149+}

1+import { LightningElement, api, track } from "lwc";


2+import { loadStyle } from "lightning/platformResourceLoader";


3+import { ShowToastEvent } from "lightning/platformShowToastEvent";


4+import formFactor from "@salesforce/client/formFactor";


5+import tailwindCSS from "@salesforce/resourceUrl/tailwindCSS_wms";


6+import getWarehouseInboundAlerts from "@salesforce/apex/WMS_UI_Wrappers.getWarehouseInboundAlerts";


7+import acknowledgeTransferAlert from "@salesforce/apex/WMS_UI_Wrappers.acknowledgeTransferAlert";


8+


9+const OVERDUE_HOURS = 4;


10+const PILL_BASE =


11+    "display: inline-block; font-size: 0.6rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04rem; padding: 0.1rem 0.45rem; border-radius: 0.75rem;";


12+


13+const TYPE_PILL_STYLES = {


14+    "Hot Transfer":


15+        PILL_BASE +


16+        " background: rgb(var(--ohfy-danger, 163 45 45)); color: rgb(var(--ohfy-surface, 255 255 255));",


17+    "Close to Code":


18+        PILL_BASE +


19+        " background: rgb(var(--ohfy-surface-muted, 244 242 240)); color: rgb(var(--ohfy-text-muted, 84 84 84));",


20+};


21+const BAND_PILL_STYLES = {


22+    Critical:


23+        PILL_BASE +


24+        " background: rgb(var(--ohfy-danger, 163 45 45)); color: rgb(var(--ohfy-surface, 255 255 255));",


25+    Act:


26+        PILL_BASE +


27+        " background: rgb(var(--ohfy-accent, 228 242 35)); color: rgb(var(--ohfy-primary, 0 0 0));",


28+    Monitor:


29+        PILL_BASE +


30+        " background: rgb(var(--ohfy-surface-muted, 244 242 240)); color: rgb(var(--ohfy-text-muted, 84 84 84));",


31+};


32+


33+export default class TransferAlertQueue extends LightningElement {


34+    @api locationId;


35+


36+    @track _alerts = [];


37+    @track isLoading = true;


38+    @track _acknowledging = new Set();


39+


40+    skeletonRows = [1, 2, 3, 4];


41+


42+    get isMobile() {


43+        return formFactor === "Small";


44+    }


45+


46+    connectedCallback() {


47+        Promise.all([loadStyle(this, tailwindCSS)]);


48+        this._load();


49+    }


50+


51+    async _load() {


52+        this.isLoading = true;


53+        try {


54+            const result = await getWarehouseInboundAlerts({ locationId: this.locationId });


55+            this._alerts = result || [];


56+        } catch (e) {


57+            this._alerts = [];


58+            this.dispatchEvent(


59+                new ShowToastEvent({


60+                    title: "Error",


61+                    message: "Failed to load transfer alerts. Please refresh.",


62+                    variant: "error",


63+                })


64+            );


65+        } finally {


66+            this.isLoading = false;


67+        }


68+    }


69+


70+    get isEmpty() {


71+        return !this.isLoading && this._alerts.length === 0;


72+    }


73+


74+    get enrichedAlerts() {


75+        const now = Date.now();


76+        const overdueMs = OVERDUE_HOURS * 60 * 60 * 1000;


77+        const sorted = [...this._alerts].sort((a, b) => {


78+            const typeOrder = x => (x.alertType === "Hot Transfer" ? 0 : 1);


79+            const bandOrder = x => ({ Critical: 0, Act: 1, Monitor: 2 })[x.urgencyBand] ?? 3;


80+            const td = typeOrder(a) - typeOrder(b);


81+            if (td !== 0) return td;


82+            const bd = bandOrder(a) - bandOrder(b);


83+            if (bd !== 0) return bd;


84+            const da = a.detectedAt ? new Date(a.detectedAt).getTime() : 0;


85+            const db = b.detectedAt ? new Date(b.detectedAt).getTime() : 0;


86+            return da - db;


87+        });


88+


89+        return sorted.map(a => {


90+            const isHot = a.alertType === "Hot Transfer";


91+            const isAcknowledged = a.status === "Acknowledged";


92+            const isOverdue =


93+                !isAcknowledged &&


94+                a.detectedAt &&


95+                now - new Date(a.detectedAt).getTime() > overdueMs;


96+


97+            let daysToCodeLabel = null;


98+            if (!isHot && a.daysToCode != null) {


99+                const d = a.daysToCode;


100+                daysToCodeLabel = d < 0 ? `${Math.abs(d)} day(s) past code` : `${d} day(s) to code`;


101+            }


102+


103+            const rowStyle = isAcknowledged


104+                ? "border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(var(--ohfy-border, 177 199 235)); opacity: 0.6;"


105+                : "border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(var(--ohfy-border, 177 199 235));";


106+


107+            return {


108+                ...a,


109+                isHot,


110+                isAcknowledged,


111+                isOverdue,


112+                showBand: !isHot && !!a.urgencyBand,


113+                alertTypeShort: isHot ? "Hot" : "CTC",


114+                typePillStyle: TYPE_PILL_STYLES[a.alertType] || TYPE_PILL_STYLES["Close to Code"],


115+                bandPillStyle: BAND_PILL_STYLES[a.urgencyBand] || BAND_PILL_STYLES.Monitor,


116+                daysToCodeLabel,


117+                showDaysToCode: !!daysToCodeLabel,


118+                itemName: a.itemName || "—",


119+                groupName: a.groupName || "—",


120+                originName: a.originName || "—",


121+                rowStyle,


122+                isAcknowledging: this._acknowledging.has(a.recordId),


123+            };


124+        });


125+    }


126+


127+    async handleAcknowledge(event) {


128+        const alertId = event.currentTarget.dataset.id;


129+        if (!alertId || this._acknowledging.has(alertId)) return;


130+


131+        this._acknowledging = new Set([...this._acknowledging, alertId]);


132+        try {


133+            await acknowledgeTransferAlert({ alertId });


134+            await this._load();


135+        } catch (e) {


136+            this.dispatchEvent(


137+                new ShowToastEvent({


138+                    title: "Error",


139+                    message: "Failed to acknowledge alert. Please try again.",


140+                    variant: "error",


141+                })


142+            );


143+        } finally {


144+            const next = new Set(this._acknowledging);


145+            next.delete(alertId);


146+            this._acknowledging = next;


147+        }


148+    }


149+}

1+/**


2+ * @description Factory/mapping logic for TransferAlertDTO. Per ADR-0007 rule 5,


3+ *              factory methods live in a sibling class (no `DTO` suffix), not on


4+ *              the global DTO itself, so the mapping can evolve without freezing


5+ *              the managed-package API surface.


6+ *


7+ *              Callers passing alerts from getAlertsForTransferGroup must set


8+ *              dto.groupName themselves after calling fromSObject — that query


9+ *              omits Transfer_Group__r.Name to avoid an extra join; accessing an


10+ *              unqueried relationship field throws SObjectException.


11+ */


12+@namespaceAccessible


13+public with sharing class TransferAlert {


14+    @namespaceAccessible


15+    public static TransferAlertDTO fromSObject(Transfer_Alert__c a) {


16+        TransferAlertDTO dto = new TransferAlertDTO();


17+        dto.recordId = a.Id;


18+        dto.alertType = a.Alert_Type__c;


19+        dto.status = a.Status__c;


20+        dto.urgencyBand = a.Urgency_Band__c;


21+        dto.daysToCode = a.Days_To_Code__c;


22+        dto.caseQuantity = a.Case_Quantity__c;


23+        dto.priorityReason = a.Priority_Reason__c;


24+        dto.detectedAt = a.Detected_At__c;


25+        dto.acknowledgedAt = a.Acknowledged_At__c;


26+        dto.acknowledgedByName = a.Acknowledged_By__r != null ? a.Acknowledged_By__r.Name : null;


27+        dto.itemName = a.Item__r != null ? a.Item__r.Name : null;


28+        dto.itemId = a.Item__c;


29+        dto.originName = a.Origin_Location__r != null ? a.Origin_Location__r.Name : null;


30+        return dto;


31+    }


32+}

1+/**

3+ *              WMS_UI_Wrappers. Using a DTO instead of a raw sObject ensures


4+ *              field names are consistent regardless of org namespace (BMS-3768).


5+ *              Per ADR-0007 (Global DTO Pattern for Cross-Package LWC Access)


6+ *              this class is `global` with `@AuraEnabled global` properties


7+ *              and only a parameterless constructor.


8+ */

57+            Alert_Type__c = 'Close to Code',

59+            Status__c = 'New',


60+            Days_To_Code__c = 7,


61+            Case_Quantity__c = 12,


62+            Priority_Reason__c = 'Test reason',


63+            Detected_At__c = Datetime.now()


64+        );


65+        insert alert;


66+


67+        // Re-query with fields fromSObject accesses (mirrors getAlertsForTransferGroup)


68+        Transfer_Alert__c reloaded = [


69+            SELECT


70+                Id,


71+                Alert_Type__c,


72+                Status__c,


73+                Urgency_Band__c,


74+                Days_To_Code__c,


75+                Case_Quantity__c,


76+                Priority_Reason__c,


77+                Detected_At__c,


78+                Acknowledged_At__c,


79+                Acknowledged_By__c,


80+                Item__c,


81+                Acknowledged_By__r.Name,


82+                Item__r.Name,


83+                Origin_Location__r.Name


84+            FROM Transfer_Alert__c


85+            WHERE Id = :alert.Id


86+        ];


87+


88+        Test.startTest();


89+        TransferAlertDTO dto = TransferAlert.fromSObject(reloaded);


90+        Test.stopTest();


91+


92+        Assert.areEqual(alert.Id, dto.recordId, 'recordId maps to Id');


93+        Assert.areEqual('Close to Code', dto.alertType, 'alertType');


94+        Assert.areEqual('New', dto.status, 'status');


95+        Assert.areEqual('Critical', dto.urgencyBand, 'urgencyBand');


96+        Assert.areEqual(7, dto.daysToCode, 'daysToCode');


97+        Assert.areEqual(12, dto.caseQuantity, 'caseQuantity');


98+        Assert.areEqual('Test reason', dto.priorityReason, 'priorityReason');


99+        Assert.isNotNull(dto.detectedAt, 'detectedAt populated');


100+        Assert.isNull(dto.acknowledgedAt, 'acknowledgedAt null for new alert');


101+        Assert.isNull(dto.acknowledgedByName, 'acknowledgedByName null for new alert');


102+        Assert.isNull(dto.itemName, 'itemName null when no Item');


103+        Assert.isNull(dto.itemId, 'itemId null when no Item');


104+        Assert.isNull(dto.groupName, 'groupName null — caller sets it when relationship queried');


105+        Assert.areEqual('OriginDTOTest', dto.originName, 'originName from Origin_Location__r.Name');


106+    }

1+/**


2+ * @description Executable for Transfer_Alert__c read and write operations (BMS-3768).


3+ *


4+ * Exposes three @namespaceAccessible operations consumed by WMS_UI_Wrappers:


5+ *  - getAlertsForTransferGroup — all alerts on a Transfer Group record page banner


6+ *  - getInboundAlertsForWarehouse — the receiving queue shown on the WMS home page


7+ *  - acknowledgeAlert — stamps Status__c = Acknowledged with user + timestamp


8+ */


9+@namespaceAccessible


10+public with sharing class E_TransferAlerts {


11+    @namespaceAccessible


12+    public static List<Transfer_Alert__c> getAlertsForTransferGroup(Id transferGroupId) {


13+        if (transferGroupId == null) {


14+            return new List<Transfer_Alert__c>();


15+        }


16+        return (List<Transfer_Alert__c>) QueryService.newBuilder(


17+                new List<String>{


18+                    'Id',


19+                    'Alert_Type__c',


20+                    'Priority_Reason__c',


21+                    'Status__c',


22+                    'Urgency_Band__c',


23+                    'Days_To_Code__c',


24+                    'Code_Date__c',


25+                    'Case_Quantity__c',


26+                    'Detected_At__c',


27+                    'Acknowledged_At__c',


28+                    'Acknowledged_By__c',


29+                    'Acknowledged_By__r.Name',


30+                    'Item__r.Name',


31+                    'Lot__r.Name',


32+                    'Origin_Location__r.Name',


33+                    'Transfer__c'


34+                },


35+                'Transfer_Alert__c'


36+            )


37+            .filters(new List<String>{ 'Transfer_Group__c = :transferGroupId' })


38+            .orderBy(


39+                new List<String>{


40+                    'Alert_Type__c DESC',


41+                    'Urgency_Band__c ASC',


42+                    'Detected_At__c ASC'


43+                }


44+            )


45+            .build()


46+            .execute(new Map<String, Object>{ 'transferGroupId' => transferGroupId });


47+    }


48+


49+    @namespaceAccessible


50+    public static List<Transfer_Alert__c> getInboundAlertsForWarehouse(Id locationId) {


51+        if (locationId == null) {


52+            return new List<Transfer_Alert__c>();


53+        }


54+        Datetime cutoff = Datetime.now().addHours(-48);


55+        return (List<Transfer_Alert__c>) QueryService.newBuilder(


56+                new List<String>{


57+                    'Id',


58+                    'Alert_Type__c',


59+                    'Priority_Reason__c',


60+                    'Status__c',


61+                    'Urgency_Band__c',


62+                    'Days_To_Code__c',


63+                    'Code_Date__c',


64+                    'Case_Quantity__c',


65+                    'Detected_At__c',


66+                    'Acknowledged_At__c',


67+                    'Acknowledged_By__c',


68+                    'Acknowledged_By__r.Name',


69+                    'Item__r.Name',


70+                    'Lot__r.Name',


71+                    'Origin_Location__r.Name',


72+                    'Transfer_Group__c',


73+                    'Transfer_Group__r.Name',


74+                    'Transfer__c'


75+                },


76+                'Transfer_Alert__c'


77+            )


78+            .filters(


79+                new List<String>{


80+                    'Receiving_Location__c = :locationId',


81+                    '(Status__c = \'New\' OR Acknowledged_At__c >= :cutoff)'


82+                }


83+            )


84+            .orderBy(


85+                new List<String>{


86+                    'Alert_Type__c DESC',


87+                    'Urgency_Band__c ASC',


88+                    'Detected_At__c ASC'


89+                }


90+            )


91+            .build()


92+            .execute(new Map<String, Object>{ 'locationId' => locationId, 'cutoff' => cutoff });


93+    }


94+


95+    @namespaceAccessible


96+    public static Integer getTransferLineCount(Id transferGroupId) {


97+        if (transferGroupId == null) {


98+            return 0;


99+        }


100+        return QueryService.newBuilder(new List<String>{ 'Id' }, 'Transfer__c')


101+            .filters(new List<String>{ 'Transfer_Group__c = :transferGroupId' })


102+            .build()


103+            .execute(new Map<String, Object>{ 'transferGroupId' => transferGroupId })


104+            .size();


105+    }


106+


107+    @namespaceAccessible


108+    public static void acknowledgeAlert(Id alertId) {


109+        if (alertId == null) {


110+            return;


111+        }


112+        try {


113+            DmlService.doUpdate(


114+                new List<Transfer_Alert__c>{


115+                    new Transfer_Alert__c(


116+                        Id = alertId,


117+                        Status__c = 'Acknowledged',


118+                        Acknowledged_By__c = UserInfo.getUserId(),


119+                        Acknowledged_At__c = Datetime.now()


120+                    )


121+                }


122+            );


123+        } catch (Exception e) {


124+            Logger.getInstance()


125+                .error('E_TransferAlerts.acknowledgeAlert failed for ' + alertId, e);


126+            Logger.getInstance().flush();


127+            throw e;


128+        }


129+    }


130+}

11+            Is_Active__c = true,

13+        );

15+        return loc;

22+            Status__c = 'New',


23+            Is_Picked__c = true,


24+            Is_External__c = false,


25+            Transfer_Date__c = System.today()


26+        );


27+        insert grp;


28+        return grp;


29+    }

31+    private static Transfer_Alert__c makeAlert(

43+            Alert_Type__c = alertType,


44+            Urgency_Band__c = band,


45+            Status__c = status,


46+            Days_To_Code__c = 5,

51+        return a;


52+    }

1+/**


2+ * @description Handler for the Transfer_Alert_Event__e platform event subscriber (BMS-3768). Each


3+ *      delivered event is materialised into a queryable Transfer_Alert__c record with Status = New


4+ *      for the receiving warehouse. The publisher is TransferGroupTriggerService.publishTransferAlerts


5+ *      (PublishBehavior.PublishAfterCommit) so events arrive only after the New -> In Progress


6+ *      transition commits.


7+ *


8+ *      Records are upserted on External_Id__c (keyed on transfer + lot) so a platform-event


9+ *      redelivery cannot create a duplicate alert. After a successful upsert, custom notifications


10+ *      are sent to holders of the WMS_Transfer_Alert_Receiver custom permission via


11+ *      S_TransferAlertNotifier. Notification failures are swallowed — they must never block retry.


12+ *      Upsert failures still propagate so the platform-event retry policy can redeliver.


13+ */


14+@namespaceAccessible


15+public with sharing class TransferAlertEventHandler {


16+    @namespaceAccessible


17+    public static void handle(List<Transfer_Alert_Event__e> events) {


18+        if (events == null || events.isEmpty()) {


19+            return;


20+        }


21+


22+        List<Transfer_Alert__c> alerts = new List<Transfer_Alert__c>();


23+        for (Transfer_Alert_Event__e ev : events) {


24+            alerts.add(


25+                new Transfer_Alert__c(


26+                    External_Id__c = 'transfer-alert:' + ev.Transfer_Id__c + ':' + ev.Lot_Id__c,


27+                    Transfer__c = toId(ev.Transfer_Id__c),


28+                    Transfer_Group__c = toId(ev.Transfer_Group_Id__c),


29+                    Item__c = toId(ev.Item_Id__c),


30+                    Lot__c = toId(ev.Lot_Id__c),


31+                    Receiving_Location__c = toId(ev.Receiving_Location_Id__c),


32+                    Origin_Location__c = toId(ev.Origin_Location_Id__c),


33+                    Case_Quantity__c = ev.Case_Quantity__c,


34+                    Code_Date__c = ev.Code_Date__c,


35+                    Days_To_Code__c = ev.Days_To_Code__c,


36+                    Urgency_Band__c = ev.Urgency_Band__c,


37+                    Detected_At__c = ev.Detected_At__c,


38+                    Alert_Type__c = ev.Alert_Type__c,


39+                    Status__c = 'New'


40+                )


41+            );


42+        }


43+


44+        try {


45+            // SYSTEM_MODE: Platform event subscriber runs as the Automated Process user with no


46+            // initiating user context, writing system-detected alert records (rule 4 in


47+            // docs/security/mode-selection.md). Upsert on External_Id__c is idempotent across the


48+            // platform-event retry budget.


49+            DmlService.doUpsert(


50+                alerts,


51+                Transfer_Alert__c.External_Id__c,


52+                true,


53+                AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE


54+            );


55+        } catch (Exception e) {


56+            // Leave a durable Log__c trail, then rethrow so the platform-event retry policy can


57+            // redeliver: a transient fault recovers on retry, and a structural one (e.g. a


58+            // validation rule / FLS added to Transfer_Alert__c) is diagnosable instead of silently


59+            // dropped once the retry budget is exhausted.


60+            Logger.getInstance()


61+                .error('TransferAlertEventHandler.handle failed to upsert transfer alerts', e);


62+            Logger.getInstance().flush();


63+            throw e;


64+        }


65+


66+        // Re-query with names needed for notification body; advisory — never block the subscriber.


67+        List<Transfer_Alert__c> alertsForNotify = queryForNotification(alerts);


68+        S_TransferAlertNotifier.notifyReceivingUsers(alertsForNotify);


69+    }


70+


71+    private static List<Transfer_Alert__c> queryForNotification(List<Transfer_Alert__c> alerts) {


72+        // Use External_Id__c (always populated) rather than Id: on platform-event redelivery the


73+        // upsert runs as an UPDATE leg and Salesforce does not back-fill Id on in-memory records


74+        // matched by an external-Id key, so a.Id would be null for every UPDATE-leg record.


75+        Set<String> externalIds = new Set<String>();


76+        for (Transfer_Alert__c a : alerts) {


77+            if (a.External_Id__c != null) {


78+                externalIds.add(a.External_Id__c);


79+            }


80+        }


81+        if (externalIds.isEmpty()) {


82+            return new List<Transfer_Alert__c>();


83+        }


84+        // SYSTEM_MODE: post-event re-query runs as Automated Process user — same rule-4 context as the upsert above.


85+        return (List<Transfer_Alert__c>) QueryService.newBuilder(


86+                new List<String>{


87+                    'Id',


88+                    'Alert_Type__c',


89+                    'Urgency_Band__c',


90+                    'Days_To_Code__c',


91+                    'Case_Quantity__c',


92+                    'Priority_Reason__c',


93+                    'Transfer_Group__c',


94+                    'Transfer_Group__r.Name',


95+                    'Item__r.Name',


96+                    'Origin_Location__r.Name'


97+                },


98+                'Transfer_Alert__c'


99+            )


100+            .filters(new List<String>{ 'External_Id__c IN :externalIds' })


101+            .build()


102+            .execute(


103+                new Map<String, Object>{ 'externalIds' => externalIds },


104+                AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE


105+            );


106+    }


107+


108+    private static Id toId(String value) {


109+        return String.isBlank(value) ? null : (Id) value;


110+    }


111+}

1+/**


2+ * @description Tests for TransferAlertEventHandler — the Transfer_Alert_Event__e subscriber


3+ *              (BMS-3768). Covers materialisation of an event into a Transfer_Alert__c, idempotent


4+ *              upsert on External_Id__c across redelivery, multi-event handling, the empty/null


5+ *              no-op guard, and the insert-failure log-and-rethrow path.


6+ */


7+@isTest


8+private class TransferAlertEventHandler_T {


9+    @TestSetup


10+    static void makeData() {


11+        Item_Line__c il = (Item_Line__c) TestDataFactory.createSObject(


12+            'Item_Line__c',


13+            new Map<String, Object>{}


14+        );


15+        Item_Type__c it = (Item_Type__c) TestDataFactory.createSObject(


16+            'Item_Type__c',


17+            new Map<String, Object>{ 'Item_Line__c' => il.Id, 'Type__c' => 'Finished Good' }


18+        );


19+        Item__c item = (Item__c) TestDataFactory.createSObject(


20+            'Item__c',


21+            new Map<String, Object>{


22+                'RecordTypeId' => Schema.SObjectType.Item__c.getRecordTypeInfosByDeveloperName()


23+                    .get('Finished_Good')


24+                    .getRecordTypeId(),


25+                'Item_Line__c' => il.Id,


26+                'Item_Type__c' => it.Id,


27+                'Name' => 'ALERT-ITEM',


28+                'Default_Case_Price__c' => 1,


29+                'Case_Quantity__c' => 1,


30+                'UOM__c' => 'US Volume',


31+                'Packaging_Type__c' => '1/2 Barrel(s)',


32+                'Average_Case_Cost__c' => 100,


33+                'Is_Lot_Tracked__c' => true


34+            }


35+        );


36+        for (Integer i = 0; i < 2; i++) {


37+            TestDataFactory.createSObject(


38+                'Lot__c',


39+                new Map<String, Object>{


40+                    'Name' => 'Lot ' + i,


41+                    'Item__c' => item.Id,


42+                    'Receipt_Date__c' => System.today() - 7,

44+                    'Cost_per_Unit__c' => 5,


45+                    'Is_Sellable__c' => true


46+                }


47+            );


48+        }


49+    }

1+/**


2+ * @description Sends Salesforce custom notifications for Transfer_Alert__c records (BMS-3768).


3+ *


4+ * Alerts are grouped by Transfer_Group__c before sending — one notification per Transfer Group,


5+ * summarising all flagged lines. This avoids notification spam when a single dispatch produces


6+ * multiple close-to-code alerts. Hot Transfer alerts are one-per-group by construction so they


7+ * collapse naturally.


8+ *


9+ * Recipient resolution mirrors E_Staging.usersWithSupervisorPermission: locate the


10+ * WMS_Transfer_Alert_Receiver custom permission, walk SetupEntityAccess to find the permission


11+ * sets that carry it, then collect all users assigned to those permission sets. All three


12+ * setup-object queries run in SYSTEM_MODE (rule 6 — cross-namespace setup reads).


13+ *


14+ * Advisory only: any failure is logged and swallowed so a notification outage never blocks


15+ * the dispatch or the hot-transfer flag save.


16+ */


17+@namespaceAccessible


18+public with sharing class S_TransferAlertNotifier {


19+    @TestVisible


20+    private static String NOTIF_TYPE_DEV_NAME = 'WMS_Transfer_Alert';


21+    @TestVisible


22+    private static final String CUSTOM_PERMISSION_NAME = 'WMS_Transfer_Alert_Receiver';


23+


24+    @TestVisible


25+    private static Set<String> recipientOverride;


26+


27+    // Tracks input batch size (0 for empty/null, -1 if never called). Test-only.


28+    @TestVisible


29+    static Integer lastNotifyBatchSize = -1;


30+


31+    // Tracks how many per-group notifications were attempted in the last call. Test-only.


32+    @TestVisible


33+    static Integer lastGroupCount = -1;


34+


35+    /**


36+     * @description Sends one WMS Transfer Alert custom notification per Transfer Group for the


37+     *              supplied alerts. No-op when the notification type is not deployed or no users


38+     *              hold the WMS_Transfer_Alert_Receiver custom permission.


39+     * @param alerts Transfer_Alert__c records with Transfer_Group__c, Transfer_Group__r.Name,


40+     *               Origin_Location__r.Name, Urgency_Band__c, Alert_Type__c, Priority_Reason__c,


41+     *               Days_To_Code__c, and Case_Quantity__c populated (caller must query these).


42+     */


43+    @namespaceAccessible


44+    public static void notifyReceivingUsers(List<Transfer_Alert__c> alerts) {


45+        lastNotifyBatchSize = (alerts == null ? 0 : alerts.size());


46+        if (alerts == null || alerts.isEmpty()) {


47+            return;


48+        }


49+


50+        try {


51+            Set<String> recipients = (recipientOverride != null)


52+                ? recipientOverride


53+                : resolveRecipients();


54+            if (recipients.isEmpty()) {


55+                return;


56+            }


57+            Id notifTypeId = getNotificationTypeId();


58+            if (notifTypeId == null) {


59+                return;


60+            }


61+


62+            // Group by Transfer Group (null key = alerts with no parent group).


63+            Map<Id, List<Transfer_Alert__c>> byGroup = new Map<Id, List<Transfer_Alert__c>>();


64+            for (Transfer_Alert__c alert : alerts) {


65+                Id groupId = alert.Transfer_Group__c;


66+                if (!byGroup.containsKey(groupId)) {


67+                    byGroup.put(groupId, new List<Transfer_Alert__c>());


68+                }


69+                byGroup.get(groupId).add(alert);


70+            }


71+


72+            lastGroupCount = byGroup.size();


73+            for (Id groupId : byGroup.keySet()) {


74+                sendForGroup(byGroup.get(groupId), groupId, notifTypeId, recipients);


75+            }


76+        } catch (Exception e) {


77+            Logger.getInstance().error('S_TransferAlertNotifier.notifyReceivingUsers failed', e);


78+            Logger.getInstance().flush();


79+        }


80+    }


81+


82+    private static void sendForGroup(


83+        List<Transfer_Alert__c> groupAlerts,


84+        Id groupId,


85+        Id notifTypeId,


86+        Set<String> recipients


87+    ) {


88+        try {


89+            String title = buildGroupTitle(groupAlerts);


90+            String body = buildGroupBody(groupAlerts);


91+            // Send to the Transfer Group record so the bell click lands on the right page.


92+            Id targetId = (groupId != null) ? groupId : groupAlerts[0].Id;


93+


94+            Messaging.CustomNotification notification = new Messaging.CustomNotification();


95+            notification.setTitle(title);


96+            notification.setBody(body);


97+            notification.setNotificationTypeId(notifTypeId);


98+            notification.setTargetId(targetId);


99+            notification.send(recipients);


100+        } catch (Exception e) {


101+            Logger.getInstance()


102+                .error('S_TransferAlertNotifier.sendForGroup failed for group ' + groupId, e);


103+            Logger.getInstance().flush();


104+        }


105+    }


106+


107+    private static String buildGroupTitle(List<Transfer_Alert__c> groupAlerts) {


108+        String tgName = null;


109+        for (Transfer_Alert__c a : groupAlerts) {


110+            if (a.Transfer_Group__r != null && a.Transfer_Group__r.Name != null) {


111+                tgName = a.Transfer_Group__r.Name;


112+                break;


113+            }


114+        }


115+


116+        for (Transfer_Alert__c a : groupAlerts) {


117+            if (a.Alert_Type__c == 'Hot Transfer') {


118+                String reason = a.Priority_Reason__c != null


119+                    ? a.Priority_Reason__c


120+                    : 'Priority shipment';


121+                return 'Hot Transfer' + (tgName != null ? ': ' + tgName : '') + ' — ' + reason;


122+            }


123+        }


124+


125+        Integer count = groupAlerts.size();


126+        return 'Transfer Alert' +


127+            (tgName != null ? ': ' + tgName : '') +


128+            ' — ' +


129+            count +


130+            ' item' +


131+            (count == 1 ? '' : 's') +


132+            ' close to code';


133+    }


134+


135+    private static String buildGroupBody(List<Transfer_Alert__c> groupAlerts) {


136+        for (Transfer_Alert__c a : groupAlerts) {


137+            if (a.Alert_Type__c == 'Hot Transfer') {


138+                String originName = (a.Origin_Location__r != null &&


139+                    a.Origin_Location__r.Name != null)


140+                    ? a.Origin_Location__r.Name


141+                    : 'Origin warehouse';


142+                return 'From ' + originName + '. Expedited handling required.';


143+            }


144+        }


145+


146+        // Find most urgent CTC alert (fewest days to code).


147+        Transfer_Alert__c mostUrgent = null;


148+        for (Transfer_Alert__c a : groupAlerts) {


149+            if (


150+                mostUrgent == null ||


151+                (a.Days_To_Code__c != null &&


152+                (mostUrgent.Days_To_Code__c == null ||


153+                a.Days_To_Code__c < mostUrgent.Days_To_Code__c))


154+            ) {


155+                mostUrgent = a;


156+            }


157+        }


158+


159+        if (mostUrgent == null) {


160+            return 'Review inbound transfer for close-to-code items.';


161+        }


162+


163+        Integer days = mostUrgent.Days_To_Code__c != null


164+            ? mostUrgent.Days_To_Code__c.intValue()


165+            : 0;


166+        String band = mostUrgent.Urgency_Band__c != null ? mostUrgent.Urgency_Band__c : 'Monitor';


167+        String originName = (mostUrgent.Origin_Location__r != null &&


168+            mostUrgent.Origin_Location__r.Name != null)


169+            ? mostUrgent.Origin_Location__r.Name


170+            : 'Origin warehouse';


171+


172+        String body = 'Most urgent: ' + days + ' day(s) (' + band + ') from ' + originName + '.';


173+        if (groupAlerts.size() > 1) {


174+            body += ' ' + groupAlerts.size() + ' items flagged.';


175+        }


176+        return body;


177+    }


178+


179+    private static Id getNotificationTypeId() {


180+        // SYSTEM_MODE: setup-object lookup for notification delivery (rule 6 in docs/security/mode-selection.md)


181+        List<CustomNotificationType> types = (List<CustomNotificationType>) QueryService.newBuilder(


182+                new List<String>{ 'Id' },


183+                'CustomNotificationType'


184+            )


185+            .filters(new List<String>{ 'DeveloperName = :devName' })


186+            .build()


187+            .execute(


188+                new Map<String, Object>{ 'devName' => NOTIF_TYPE_DEV_NAME },


189+                AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE


190+            );


191+        return types.isEmpty() ? null : types[0].Id;


192+    }


193+


194+    private static Set<String> resolveRecipients() {


195+        Set<String> userIds = new Set<String>();


196+


197+        // SYSTEM_MODE: setup-object lookups for notification recipient resolution (rule 6 in docs/security/mode-selection.md)


198+        List<CustomPermission> perms = (List<CustomPermission>) QueryService.newBuilder(


199+                new List<String>{ 'Id' },


200+                'CustomPermission'


201+            )


202+            .filters(new List<String>{ 'DeveloperName = :devName' })


203+            .build()


204+            .execute(


205+                new Map<String, Object>{ 'devName' => CUSTOM_PERMISSION_NAME },


206+                AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE


207+            );


208+        if (perms.isEmpty()) {


209+            return userIds;


210+        }


211+        Set<Id> permIds = new Map<Id, CustomPermission>(perms).keySet();


212+


213+        // SYSTEM_MODE: setup-object lookups for notification recipient resolution (rule 6 in docs/security/mode-selection.md)


214+        List<SetupEntityAccess> access = (List<SetupEntityAccess>) QueryService.newBuilder(


215+                new List<String>{ 'Id', 'ParentId' },


216+                'SetupEntityAccess'


217+            )


218+            .filters(


219+                new List<String>{ 'SetupEntityType = :entityType', 'SetupEntityId IN :permIds' }


220+            )


221+            .build()


222+            .execute(


223+                new Map<String, Object>{ 'entityType' => 'CustomPermission', 'permIds' => permIds },


224+                AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE


225+            );


226+        if (access.isEmpty()) {


227+            return userIds;


228+        }


229+        Set<Id> permissionSetIds = new Set<Id>();


230+        for (SetupEntityAccess sea : access) {


231+            permissionSetIds.add(sea.ParentId);


232+        }


233+


234+        // SYSTEM_MODE: setup-object lookups for notification recipient resolution (rule 6 in docs/security/mode-selection.md)


235+        List<PermissionSetAssignment> assignments = (List<PermissionSetAssignment>) QueryService.newBuilder(


236+                new List<String>{ 'Id', 'AssigneeId' },


237+                'PermissionSetAssignment'


238+            )


239+            .filters(new List<String>{ 'PermissionSetId IN :permissionSetIds' })


240+            .build()


241+            .execute(


242+                new Map<String, Object>{ 'permissionSetIds' => permissionSetIds },


243+                AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE


244+            );


245+        for (PermissionSetAssignment psa : assignments) {


246+            userIds.add(psa.AssigneeId);


247+        }


248+        return userIds;


249+    }

1+/**


2+ * @description Internal Transfer Alerts evaluator (BMS-3768).


3+ *


4+ * When a Transfer Group is dispatched (New -> In Progress), this service inspects each of its


5+ * Transfer__c lines and decides whether the receiving warehouse should be alerted that the inbound


6+ * product is close to code. It builds one Transfer_Alert_Event__e per flagged line; the publisher


7+ * (TransferGroupTriggerService.publishTransferAlerts) raises them and a subscriber materialises each


8+ * into a queryable Transfer_Alert__c (TransferAlertEventHandler).


9+ *


10+ * Close-to-code classification reuses the existing close-to-code config — CTC_Threshold__mdt


11+ * (Warehouse_Code__c, Item_Category__c, Code_Date_Threshold_Days__c, Act_Band_Days__c,


12+ * Critical_Band_Days__c) — resolved against the RECEIVING warehouse's location code so urgency


13+ * reflects the destination's code-date tolerance (Gulf FL vs AL via per-warehouse rows). No new


14+ * threshold is introduced. The shipping lot is the soonest-expiring sellable lot of the line's item


15+ * at the origin location (FEFO): the lot most at risk of crossing code before it can be sold through.


16+ *


17+ * Bulk-safe: every supporting query is set-based and the evaluation is per-line. Non-lot-tracked


18+ * items (no sellable lot with an expiration at origin) produce no alert.


19+ */


20+public with sharing class S_TransferAlerts {


21+    @TestVisible


22+    private static List<CTC_Threshold__mdt> thresholdOverride;


23+    @TestVisible


24+    private static Datetime detectedAtOverride;


25+    @TestVisible


26+    private static Boolean failForTest = false;


27+


28+    private class TransferAlertException extends Exception {


29+    }


30+


31+    @TestVisible


32+    private static final String BAND_CRITICAL = 'Critical';


33+    @TestVisible


34+    private static final String BAND_ACT = 'Act';


35+    @TestVisible


36+    private static final String BAND_MONITOR = 'Monitor';


37+


38+    /**


39+     * @description Builds the Transfer_Alert_Event__e events for every close-to-code line on the


40+     *              supplied dispatched Transfer Groups. Returns an empty list (never null) when


41+     *              nothing qualifies. Does not publish — the caller owns EventBus.publish so the


42+     *              publish/retry policy lives with the trigger service.


43+     * @param transferGroupIds Transfer_Group__c ids that just advanced New -> In Progress


44+     * @return one event per flagged Transfer line (item within the receiving warehouse's CTC band)


45+     */


46+    public static List<Transfer_Alert_Event__e> buildAlertEvents(Set<Id> transferGroupIds) {


47+        List<Transfer_Alert_Event__e> events = new List<Transfer_Alert_Event__e>();


48+        if (Test.isRunningTest() && failForTest) {


49+            throw new TransferAlertException('Forced failure for publish catch-path coverage');


50+        }


51+        if (transferGroupIds == null || transferGroupIds.isEmpty()) {


52+            return events;


53+        }


54+


55+        Map<Id, Transfer_Group__c> groupsById = loadGroups(transferGroupIds);


56+        if (groupsById.isEmpty()) {


57+            return events;


58+        }


59+        List<Transfer__c> lines = loadLines(transferGroupIds);


60+        if (lines.isEmpty()) {


61+            return events;


62+        }


63+


64+        Set<Id> itemIds = new Set<Id>();


65+        Set<Id> originIds = new Set<Id>();


66+        Set<Id> destIds = new Set<Id>();


67+        for (Transfer_Group__c grp : groupsById.values()) {


68+            if (grp.Origin_Location__c != null) {


69+                originIds.add(grp.Origin_Location__c);


70+            }


71+            if (grp.New_Location__c != null) {


72+                destIds.add(grp.New_Location__c);


73+            }


74+        }


75+        for (Transfer__c line : lines) {


76+            if (line.Item__c != null) {


77+                itemIds.add(line.Item__c);


78+            }


79+        }


80+        if (itemIds.isEmpty() || originIds.isEmpty() || destIds.isEmpty()) {


81+            return events;


82+        }


83+


84+        Map<String, Lot_Inventory__c> earliestLotByOriginItem = loadEarliestLots(


85+            itemIds,


86+            originIds


87+        );


88+        if (earliestLotByOriginItem.isEmpty()) {


89+            return events; // nothing lot-tracked / nothing with an expiry at origin


90+        }


91+        Map<Id, String> codeByLocation = loadLocationCodes(destIds);


92+        Map<Id, String> categoryByItem = loadItemCategories(itemIds);


93+        List<CTC_Threshold__mdt> thresholds = getThresholds();


94+


95+        Datetime detectedAt = (detectedAtOverride != null) ? detectedAtOverride : Datetime.now();


96+        Date evalDate = detectedAt.date();


97+


98+        for (Transfer__c line : lines) {


99+            Transfer_Group__c grp = groupsById.get(line.Transfer_Group__c);


100+            if (


101+                grp == null ||


102+                grp.Origin_Location__c == null ||


103+                grp.New_Location__c == null ||


104+                line.Item__c == null


105+            ) {


106+                continue;


107+            }


108+            Lot_Inventory__c fefo = earliestLotByOriginItem.get(


109+                grp.Origin_Location__c + '|' + line.Item__c


110+            );


111+            if (fefo == null || fefo.Lot__r == null || fefo.Lot__r.Expiration_Date__c == null) {


112+                continue; // non-lot-tracked, or no sellable lot with a code date at origin


113+            }


114+


115+            Date codeDate = fefo.Lot__r.Expiration_Date__c;


116+            Integer daysToCode = evalDate.daysBetween(codeDate);


117+            CTC_Threshold__mdt threshold = resolveThreshold(


118+                thresholds,


119+                codeByLocation.get(grp.New_Location__c),


120+                categoryByItem.get(line.Item__c)


121+            );


122+            if (


123+                threshold == null ||


124+                threshold.Code_Date_Threshold_Days__c == null ||


125+                daysToCode > threshold.Code_Date_Threshold_Days__c


126+            ) {


127+                continue; // not close to code under the receiving warehouse's band


128+            }


129+


130+            events.add(


131+                new Transfer_Alert_Event__e(


132+                    Transfer_Id__c = line.Id,


133+                    Transfer_Group_Id__c = grp.Id,


134+                    Item_Id__c = line.Item__c,


135+                    Lot_Id__c = fefo.Lot__c,


136+                    Receiving_Location_Id__c = grp.New_Location__c,


137+                    Origin_Location_Id__c = grp.Origin_Location__c,


138+                    Case_Quantity__c = line.Transfer_Quantity_Cases__c,


139+                    Code_Date__c = codeDate,


140+                    Days_To_Code__c = daysToCode,


141+                    Urgency_Band__c = deriveBand(daysToCode, threshold),


142+                    Detected_At__c = detectedAt,


143+                    Alert_Type__c = 'Close to Code'


144+                )


145+            );


146+        }


147+        return events;


148+    }


149+


150+    /**


151+     * @description Urgency band for a close-to-code line, mirroring the CTC engine's priority bands:


152+     *              Critical within Critical_Band_Days__c, Act within Act_Band_Days__c, else Monitor.


153+     */


154+    @TestVisible


155+    private static String deriveBand(Integer daysToCode, CTC_Threshold__mdt threshold) {


156+        if (


157+            threshold.Critical_Band_Days__c != null &&


158+            daysToCode <= threshold.Critical_Band_Days__c


159+        ) {


160+            return BAND_CRITICAL;


161+        }


162+        if (threshold.Act_Band_Days__c != null && daysToCode <= threshold.Act_Band_Days__c) {


163+            return BAND_ACT;


164+        }


165+        return BAND_MONITOR;


166+    }


167+


168+    /**


169+     * @description Resolves the most specific active threshold for a receiving warehouse code + item


170+     *              category, falling back through wildcards: exact, category-wildcard,


171+     *              warehouse-wildcard, then the all-wildcard default. Same precedence as


172+     *              S_CTCSuggestionEngine.resolveThreshold so transfer urgency and on-hand


173+     *              suggestions classify code dates identically.


174+     */


175+    @TestVisible


176+    private static CTC_Threshold__mdt resolveThreshold(


177+        List<CTC_Threshold__mdt> thresholds,


178+        String warehouseCode,


179+        String category


180+    ) {


181+        CTC_Threshold__mdt exact = null;


182+        CTC_Threshold__mdt whWild = null;


183+        CTC_Threshold__mdt catWild = null;


184+        CTC_Threshold__mdt allWild = null;


185+        for (CTC_Threshold__mdt t : thresholds) {


186+            if (t.Is_Active__c != true) {


187+                continue;


188+            }


189+            Boolean whMatch = t.Warehouse_Code__c == warehouseCode;


190+            Boolean whIsWild = t.Warehouse_Code__c == '*';


191+            Boolean catMatch = t.Item_Category__c == category;


192+            Boolean catIsWild = t.Item_Category__c == '*';


193+            if (whMatch && catMatch) {


194+                exact = t;


195+            } else if (whMatch && catIsWild) {


196+                whWild = t;


197+            } else if (whIsWild && catMatch) {


198+                catWild = t;


199+            } else if (whIsWild && catIsWild) {


200+                allWild = t;


201+            }


202+        }


203+        if (exact != null) {


204+            return exact;


205+        }


206+        if (catWild != null) {


207+            return catWild;


208+        }


209+        if (whWild != null) {


210+            return whWild;


211+        }


212+        return allWild;


213+    }


214+

216+    // Loaders


217+    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

223+                    'Transfer_Group__c'


224+                )


225+                .filters(new List<String>{ 'Id IN :transferGroupIds' })


226+                .build()


227+                .execute(new Map<String, Object>{ 'transferGroupIds' => transferGroupIds })


228+        );

232+        return (List<Transfer__c>) QueryService.newBuilder(


233+                new List<String>{


234+                    'Id',


235+                    'Item__c',


236+                    'Transfer_Group__c',


237+                    'Transfer_Quantity_Cases__c'


238+                },


239+                'Transfer__c'


240+            )

242+            .build()


243+            .execute(new Map<String, Object>{ 'transferGroupIds' => transferGroupIds });

246+    /**


247+     * @description The soonest-expiring sellable, on-hand lot of each item at each origin location


248+     *              (FEFO). Keyed 'originLocationId|itemId'. Computes the minimum in Apex so the


249+     *              method does not depend on SOQL ordering of the lot-inventory query.


250+     */


251+    private static Map<String, Lot_Inventory__c> loadEarliestLots(


252+        Set<Id> itemIds,


253+        Set<Id> originIds


254+    ) {


255+        Map<String, Lot_Inventory__c> earliest = new Map<String, Lot_Inventory__c>();


256+        List<Lot_Inventory__c> lotInvs = (List<Lot_Inventory__c>) QueryService.newBuilder(


257+                new List<String>{


258+                    'Id',


259+                    'Lot__c',


260+                    'Lot__r.Expiration_Date__c',


261+                    'Inventory__r.Item__c',


262+                    'Inventory__r.Location__c',


263+                    'Quantity_On_Hand__c'


264+                },


265+                'Lot_Inventory__c'


266+            )


267+            .filters(


268+                new List<String>{


269+                    'Inventory__r.Item__c IN :itemIds',


270+                    'Inventory__r.Location__c IN :originIds',


271+                    'Quantity_On_Hand__c > 0',


272+                    'Lot__r.Is_Sellable__c = true',


273+                    'Lot__r.Expiration_Date__c != null'


274+                }


275+            )


276+            .build()


277+            .execute(new Map<String, Object>{ 'itemIds' => itemIds, 'originIds' => originIds });


278+        for (Lot_Inventory__c li : lotInvs) {


279+            if (


280+                li.Inventory__r == null ||


281+                li.Inventory__r.Item__c == null ||


282+                li.Inventory__r.Location__c == null ||


283+                li.Lot__r == null ||


284+                li.Lot__r.Expiration_Date__c == null


285+            ) {


286+                continue;


287+            }


288+            String key = li.Inventory__r.Location__c + '|' + li.Inventory__r.Item__c;


289+            Lot_Inventory__c incumbent = earliest.get(key);


290+            if (


291+                incumbent == null ||


292+                li.Lot__r.Expiration_Date__c < incumbent.Lot__r.Expiration_Date__c


293+            ) {


294+                earliest.put(key, li);


295+            }


296+        }


297+        return earliest;


298+    }

305+            )

307+            .build()


308+            .execute(new Map<String, Object>{ 'locationIds' => locationIds });


309+        for (Location__c loc : locs) {

324+        for (Item__c item : items) {

326+        }

328+    }

330+    private static List<CTC_Threshold__mdt> getThresholds() {


331+        if (thresholdOverride != null) {


332+            return thresholdOverride;


333+        }


334+        // SYSTEM_MODE: Custom Metadata Type lookup — configuration, not user data (rule 1 in


335+        // docs/security/mode-selection.md).


336+        return (List<CTC_Threshold__mdt>) QueryService.newBuilder(


337+                new List<String>{


338+                    'Warehouse_Code__c',


339+                    'Item_Category__c',


340+                    'Code_Date_Threshold_Days__c',


341+                    'Act_Band_Days__c',


342+                    'Critical_Band_Days__c',


343+                    'Is_Active__c'


344+                },


345+                'CTC_Threshold__mdt'


346+            )


347+            .build()


348+            .execute(new Map<String, Object>(), AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE);


349+    }

1+/**


2+ * @description Tests for S_TransferAlertNotifier (BMS-3768). Covers notification sends for CTC


3+ * and Hot Transfer alerts, per-Transfer-Group grouping, the no-op when no recipients are assigned,


4+ * and the guard when no alerts are supplied. The recipientOverride bypass avoids needing a real


5+ * permission set assignment in the test org; the notification send itself is tested via


6+ * CustomNotification (sandbox-safe no-op).


7+ */


8+@isTest


9+private class S_TransferAlertNotifier_T {


10+    private static Transfer_Alert__c makeAlert(String alertType, String band) {


11+        Transfer_Alert__c a = new Transfer_Alert__c(


12+            Alert_Type__c = alertType,


13+            Urgency_Band__c = band,


14+            Days_To_Code__c = 5,


15+            Case_Quantity__c = 10,


16+            Priority_Reason__c = alertType == 'Hot Transfer' ? 'Promotion' : null


17+        );


18+        insert a;


19+        return [


20+            SELECT


21+                Id,


22+                Alert_Type__c,


23+                Urgency_Band__c,


24+                Days_To_Code__c,


25+                Case_Quantity__c,


26+                Priority_Reason__c,


27+                Transfer_Group__c,


28+                Transfer_Group__r.Name,


29+                Item__r.Name,


30+                Origin_Location__r.Name


31+            FROM Transfer_Alert__c


32+            WHERE Id = :a.Id


33+        ];


34+    }


35+


36+    @isTest


37+    static void notifyNoOpsOnEmptyAndNull() {


38+        Test.startTest();


39+        S_TransferAlertNotifier.notifyReceivingUsers(null);


40+        S_TransferAlertNotifier.notifyReceivingUsers(new List<Transfer_Alert__c>());


41+        Test.stopTest();


42+        Assert.areEqual(0, S_TransferAlertNotifier.lastNotifyBatchSize, 'Empty batch tracked');


43+    }


44+


45+    @isTest


46+    static void notifyNoOpsWhenNoRecipients() {


47+        S_TransferAlertNotifier.recipientOverride = new Set<String>();


48+        Transfer_Alert__c alert = makeAlert('Close to Code', 'Critical');


49+


50+        Test.startTest();


51+        S_TransferAlertNotifier.notifyReceivingUsers(new List<Transfer_Alert__c>{ alert });


52+        Test.stopTest();


53+


54+        Assert.areEqual(1, S_TransferAlertNotifier.lastNotifyBatchSize, 'Batch size tracked');


55+        // lastGroupCount stays -1 because recipients were empty — send loop never runs.


56+        Assert.areEqual(-1, S_TransferAlertNotifier.lastGroupCount, 'Group loop skipped');


57+    }


58+


59+    @isTest


60+    static void ctcAlertSendsOneNotification() {


61+        S_TransferAlertNotifier.recipientOverride = new Set<String>{ UserInfo.getUserId() };


62+        Transfer_Alert__c alert = makeAlert('Close to Code', 'Critical');


63+


64+        Test.startTest();


65+        S_TransferAlertNotifier.notifyReceivingUsers(new List<Transfer_Alert__c>{ alert });


66+        Test.stopTest();


67+


68+        Assert.areEqual(1, S_TransferAlertNotifier.lastGroupCount, 'One group for one alert');


69+    }


70+


71+    @isTest


72+    static void hotTransferAlertSendsOneNotification() {


73+        S_TransferAlertNotifier.recipientOverride = new Set<String>{ UserInfo.getUserId() };


74+        Transfer_Alert__c alert = makeAlert('Hot Transfer', null);


75+


76+        Test.startTest();


77+        S_TransferAlertNotifier.notifyReceivingUsers(new List<Transfer_Alert__c>{ alert });


78+        Test.stopTest();


79+


80+        Assert.areEqual(1, S_TransferAlertNotifier.lastGroupCount, 'One group for hot transfer');


81+    }


82+


83+    @isTest


84+    static void multipleAlertsNoGroupCollapsesToOneNotification() {


85+        // Alerts without a Transfer Group (null key) should collapse to a single notification.


86+        S_TransferAlertNotifier.recipientOverride = new Set<String>{ UserInfo.getUserId() };


87+        List<Transfer_Alert__c> alerts = new List<Transfer_Alert__c>{


88+            makeAlert('Close to Code', 'Act'),

90+        };


91+


92+        Test.startTest();


93+        S_TransferAlertNotifier.notifyReceivingUsers(alerts);


94+        Test.stopTest();


95+


96+        Assert.areEqual(


97+            1,


98+            S_TransferAlertNotifier.lastGroupCount,


99+            'Two ungrouped alerts collapse to one notification'


100+        );

102+


103+    @isTest


104+    static void noOpsWhenNotificationTypeNotDeployed() {


105+        // Drive the notifTypeId == null branch by pointing the lookup at a non-existent type.


106+        S_TransferAlertNotifier.NOTIF_TYPE_DEV_NAME = 'Nonexistent_Notification_Type_XYZ';


107+        S_TransferAlertNotifier.recipientOverride = new Set<String>{ UserInfo.getUserId() };


108+        Transfer_Alert__c alert = makeAlert('Close to Code', 'Critical');

110+        Test.startTest();

116+            -1,


117+            S_TransferAlertNotifier.lastGroupCount,


118+            'Group loop skipped when type missing'


119+        );


120+    }

131+        Test.startTest();


132+        S_TransferAlertNotifier.notifyReceivingUsers(alerts);


133+        Test.stopTest();

135+        Assert.areEqual(


136+            1,


137+            S_TransferAlertNotifier.lastGroupCount,


138+            'Mixed types with same null group send one notification'


139+        );


140+    }

1+/**


2+ * @description Tests for S_TransferAlerts — the Internal Transfer Alerts evaluator (BMS-3768).


3+ *              Covers in-band (Critical/Act/Monitor) classification, out-of-band suppression,


4+ *              non-lot-tracked items, FEFO lot selection, already-out-of-code lots, per-warehouse


5+ *              threshold resolution, the wildcard fallback ladder, and the end-to-end dispatch path


6+ *              (New -> In Progress publishes the event and lands a Transfer_Alert__c).


7+ */


8+@isTest


9+private class S_TransferAlerts_T {


10+    private static final Integer THRESHOLD_DAYS = 30;


11+    private static final Integer ACT_DAYS = 14;


12+    private static final Integer CRITICAL_DAYS = 7;

144+    @isTest


145+    static void inBandCriticalLotBuildsAlert() {


146+        Id origin = warehouse('McCalla', 'MCAL').Id;


147+        Id dest = warehouse('Milton', 'MILTN').Id;


148+        Id itemId = lotTrackedItem('CTC-CRIT');


149+        Id invId = inventory(origin, itemId);


150+        lotInventory(invId, lot(itemId, System.today() + 5), 100);


151+        Transfer_Group__c grp = newGroup(origin, dest);


152+        line(grp.Id, itemId, 12);

154+        S_TransferAlerts.thresholdOverride = wildcardThreshold();


155+


156+        Test.startTest();


157+        List<Transfer_Alert_Event__e> events = S_TransferAlerts.buildAlertEvents(


158+            new Set<Id>{ grp.Id }


159+        );


160+        Test.stopTest();


161+


162+        System.Assert.areEqual(1, events.size(), 'A lot 5 days from code should raise one alert');


163+        Transfer_Alert_Event__e ev = events[0];


164+        System.Assert.areEqual(


165+            'Critical',


166+            ev.Urgency_Band__c,


167+            '5 days <= critical band (7) = Critical'


168+        );


169+        System.Assert.areEqual(5, ev.Days_To_Code__c, 'Days-to-code captured');


170+        System.Assert.areEqual(12, ev.Case_Quantity__c, 'Transfer case quantity captured');


171+        System.Assert.areEqual(itemId, ev.Item_Id__c, 'Item captured');


172+        System.Assert.areEqual(dest, ev.Receiving_Location_Id__c, 'Receiving warehouse captured');


173+        System.Assert.areEqual(origin, ev.Origin_Location_Id__c, 'Origin warehouse captured');


174+        System.Assert.isNotNull(ev.Lot_Id__c, 'Lot captured');


175+        System.Assert.isNotNull(ev.Code_Date__c, 'Code date captured');


176+        System.Assert.areEqual('Close to Code', ev.Alert_Type__c, 'Alert_Type__c set on CTC event');


177+    }

231+    @isTest


232+    static void outOfBandLotProducesNoAlert() {

391+    @isTest


392+    static void resolveThresholdPrecedenceAndDeriveBand() {


393+        CTC_Threshold__mdt exact = new CTC_Threshold__mdt(


394+            Warehouse_Code__c = 'MILTN',


395+            Item_Category__c = 'Beer',


396+            Code_Date_Threshold_Days__c = 30,


397+            Act_Band_Days__c = 14,


398+            Critical_Band_Days__c = 7,


399+            Is_Active__c = true


400+        );


401+        CTC_Threshold__mdt catWild = new CTC_Threshold__mdt(


402+            Warehouse_Code__c = '*',


403+            Item_Category__c = 'Beer',


404+            Code_Date_Threshold_Days__c = 20,


405+            Is_Active__c = true


406+        );


407+        CTC_Threshold__mdt whWild = new CTC_Threshold__mdt(


408+            Warehouse_Code__c = 'MILTN',


409+            Item_Category__c = '*',


410+            Code_Date_Threshold_Days__c = 25,


411+            Is_Active__c = true


412+        );


413+        CTC_Threshold__mdt allWild = new CTC_Threshold__mdt(


414+            Warehouse_Code__c = '*',


415+            Item_Category__c = '*',


416+            Code_Date_Threshold_Days__c = 10,


417+            Is_Active__c = true


418+        );


419+        CTC_Threshold__mdt inactive = new CTC_Threshold__mdt(


420+            Warehouse_Code__c = 'MILTN',


421+            Item_Category__c = 'Beer',


422+            Code_Date_Threshold_Days__c = 99,


423+            Is_Active__c = false


424+        );


425+        List<CTC_Threshold__mdt> all = new List<CTC_Threshold__mdt>{


426+            allWild,


427+            whWild,


428+            catWild,


429+            exact,


430+            inactive


431+        };


432+


433+        // Exact match wins and inactive same-key row is ignored.


434+        System.Assert.areEqual(


435+            30,


436+            S_TransferAlerts.resolveThreshold(all, 'MILTN', 'Beer').Code_Date_Threshold_Days__c,


437+            'Exact (warehouse+category) match should win'


438+        );


439+        // No exact -> category-wildcard beats warehouse-wildcard.


440+        System.Assert.areEqual(


441+            25,


442+            S_TransferAlerts.resolveThreshold(


443+                    new List<CTC_Threshold__mdt>{ allWild, whWild, catWild },


444+                    'MILTN',


445+                    'Wine'


446+                )


447+                .Code_Date_Threshold_Days__c,


448+            'No exact: category-wildcard (wh match) precedence'


449+        );


450+        // Only the all-wildcard applies for an unknown warehouse + category.


451+        System.Assert.areEqual(


452+            10,


453+            S_TransferAlerts.resolveThreshold(all, 'NOWHERE', 'Spirits')


454+                .Code_Date_Threshold_Days__c,


455+            'Unknown warehouse/category falls back to all-wildcard'


456+        );


457+        // No active row matches.


458+        System.Assert.isNull(


459+            S_TransferAlerts.resolveThreshold(


460+                new List<CTC_Threshold__mdt>{ inactive },


461+                'MILTN',


462+                'Beer'


463+            ),


464+            'Only an inactive row -> no threshold'


465+        );


466+


467+        // deriveBand edges, including null band fields.


468+        System.Assert.areEqual(


469+            'Critical',


470+            S_TransferAlerts.deriveBand(7, exact),


471+            '7 <= critical 7'


472+        );


473+        System.Assert.areEqual('Act', S_TransferAlerts.deriveBand(8, exact), '8 within act 14');


474+        System.Assert.areEqual('Monitor', S_TransferAlerts.deriveBand(15, exact), '15 > act 14');


475+        System.Assert.areEqual(


476+            'Monitor',


477+            S_TransferAlerts.deriveBand(1, catWild),


478+            'Null band fields fall through to Monitor'


479+        );


480+    }
