114+    /**


115+     * @description Internal Transfer Alerts (BMS-3768). When a Transfer Group is dispatched


116+     * (New -> In Progress), publishes a Transfer_Alert_Event__e for each line shipping close-to-code


117+     * product so the receiving warehouse is notified to prioritise dock processing. Urgency is


118+     * classified against the RECEIVING warehouse's CTC_Threshold__mdt band (S_TransferAlerts).


119+     *


120+     * Alerts are advisory: any failure to build or publish them is logged and swallowed so it can


121+     * never block the dispatch transition. Events use PublishAfterCommit, so they are delivered only


122+     * after this transaction commits; a subscriber (TransferAlertEventHandler) lands each as a


123+     * queryable Transfer_Alert__c. Only the New -> In Progress edge is gated, matching


124+     * enforceMinTransferQuantity — status cannot move backwards, so the alert fires once per group.


125+     *


126+     * @param newTransferGroups Transfer_Group__c records with new values


127+     * @param oldTransferGroups Transfer_Group__c records with previous values


128+     */


129+    @TestVisible


130+    private void publishTransferAlerts(


131+        List<Transfer_Group__c> newTransferGroups,


132+        List<Transfer_Group__c> oldTransferGroups


133+    ) {


134+        Map<Id, Transfer_Group__c> oldMap = new Map<Id, Transfer_Group__c>(oldTransferGroups);


135+        Set<Id> dispatchedGroupIds = new Set<Id>();


136+        for (Transfer_Group__c tg : newTransferGroups) {


137+            Transfer_Group__c old = oldMap.get(tg.Id);


138+            if (tg.Status__c == 'In Progress' && old != null && old.Status__c == 'New') {


139+                dispatchedGroupIds.add(tg.Id);


140+            }


141+        }


142+        if (dispatchedGroupIds.isEmpty()) {


143+            return;


144+        }


145+


146+        try {


147+            List<Transfer_Alert_Event__e> events = S_TransferAlerts.buildAlertEvents(


148+                dispatchedGroupIds


149+            );


150+            if (events.isEmpty()) {


151+                return;


152+            }


153+            // PublishAfterCommit: delivered only once this transaction commits. Mirrors the advisory


154+            // EventBus.publish in InventoryAdjustmentTriggerService.afterInsert (Negative Inventory).


155+            EventBus.publish(events);


156+        } catch (Exception e) {


157+            // Alerts are advisory and must never block the dispatch — log and swallow.


158+            Logger.getInstance()


159+                .error('TransferGroupTriggerService.publishTransferAlerts failed', e);


160+            Logger.getInstance().flush();


161+        }


162+    }


163+


164+    /**


165+     * @description Hot Transfer Alerts (BMS-3768). When a Transfer Group's Is_Hot_Transfer__c is


166+     * toggled from false to true, creates a Transfer_Alert__c of type 'Hot Transfer' directly for


167+     * the receiving warehouse and sends a platform notification to receiving staff.


168+     *


169+     * Idempotent: the alert is upserted on External_Id__c = 'hot-alert:{groupId}', so toggling


170+     * the flag off and on again does not create a duplicate. Advisory: failures are logged and


171+     * swallowed so they never block the field save.


172+     */


173+    @TestVisible


174+    private void publishHotTransferAlerts(


175+        List<Transfer_Group__c> newTransferGroups,


176+        List<Transfer_Group__c> oldTransferGroups


177+    ) {


178+        Map<Id, Transfer_Group__c> oldMap = new Map<Id, Transfer_Group__c>(oldTransferGroups);


179+        List<Transfer_Alert__c> hotAlerts = new List<Transfer_Alert__c>();


180+        for (Transfer_Group__c tg : newTransferGroups) {


181+            Transfer_Group__c old = oldMap.get(tg.Id);


182+            Boolean wasHot = old != null && old.Is_Hot_Transfer__c == true;


183+            Boolean isHot = tg.Is_Hot_Transfer__c == true;


184+            if (!wasHot && isHot && tg.New_Location__c != null) {


185+                hotAlerts.add(


186+                    new Transfer_Alert__c(


187+                        External_Id__c = 'hot-alert:' + tg.Id,


188+                        Transfer_Group__c = tg.Id,


189+                        Receiving_Location__c = tg.New_Location__c,


190+                        Origin_Location__c = tg.Origin_Location__c,


191+                        Alert_Type__c = 'Hot Transfer',


192+                        Priority_Reason__c = tg.Hot_Transfer_Priority_Reason__c,


193+                        Status__c = 'New',


194+                        Detected_At__c = Datetime.now()


195+                    )


196+                );


197+            }


198+        }


199+        if (hotAlerts.isEmpty()) {


200+            return;


201+        }


202+


203+        try {


204+            DmlService.doUpsert(hotAlerts, Transfer_Alert__c.External_Id__c, true);


205+            // Re-query by External_Id__c — Database.upsert does not back-fill Id on the


206+            // in-memory record for UPDATE legs (external-Id match), so collecting a.Id here


207+            // would miss re-toggles.  External_Id__c is always set before the upsert.


208+            Set<String> externalIds = new Set<String>();


209+            for (Transfer_Alert__c a : hotAlerts) {


210+                externalIds.add(a.External_Id__c);


211+            }


212+            List<Transfer_Alert__c> alertsForNotify = (List<Transfer_Alert__c>) QueryService.newBuilder(


213+                    new List<String>{


214+                        'Id',


215+                        'Alert_Type__c',


216+                        'Priority_Reason__c',


217+                        'Case_Quantity__c',


218+                        'Transfer_Group__c',


219+                        'Transfer_Group__r.Name',


220+                        'Origin_Location__r.Name'


221+                    },


222+                    'Transfer_Alert__c'


223+                )


224+                .filters(new List<String>{ 'External_Id__c IN :externalIds' })


225+                .build()


226+                .execute(new Map<String, Object>{ 'externalIds' => externalIds });


227+            S_TransferAlertNotifier.notifyReceivingUsers(alertsForNotify);


228+        } catch (Exception e) {


229+            Logger.getInstance()


230+                .error('TransferGroupTriggerService.publishHotTransferAlerts failed', e);


231+            Logger.getInstance().flush();


232+        }


233+    }

996+    static void hotTransferToggleCreatesHotAlert() {


997+        originWarehouseId = [SELECT Id FROM Location__c WHERE Name = 'Milton FL' LIMIT 1].Id;


998+        destinationWarehouseId = [


999+            SELECT Id


1000+            FROM Location__c


1001+            WHERE Name = 'Montgomery AL'


1002+            LIMIT 1


1003+        ]


1004+        .Id;


1005+


1006+        S_TransferAlertNotifier.recipientOverride = new Set<String>();


1007+        Transfer_Group__c tg = (Transfer_Group__c) TestDataFactory.createSObject(


1008+            'Transfer_Group__c',


1009+            new Map<String, Object>{


1010+                'Origin_Location__c' => originWarehouseId,


1011+                'New_Location__c' => destinationWarehouseId,


1012+                'Status__c' => 'In Progress',


1013+                'Is_Picked__c' => true,


1014+                'Is_External__c' => false,


1015+                'Transfer_Date__c' => System.today(),


1016+                'Is_Hot_Transfer__c' => false


1017+            }


1018+        );


1019+


1020+        Test.startTest();


1021+        tg.Is_Hot_Transfer__c = true;


1022+        tg.Hot_Transfer_Priority_Reason__c = 'Promotion';


1023+        update tg;


1024+        Test.stopTest();


1025+


1026+        List<Transfer_Alert__c> alerts = [


1027+            SELECT Alert_Type__c, Priority_Reason__c, Status__c, External_Id__c


1028+            FROM Transfer_Alert__c


1029+            WHERE Transfer_Group__c = :tg.Id AND Alert_Type__c = 'Hot Transfer'


1030+        ];


1031+        System.Assert.areEqual(1, alerts.size(), 'One Hot Transfer alert created on flag toggle');


1032+        System.Assert.areEqual(


1033+            'Hot Transfer',


1034+            alerts[0].Alert_Type__c,


1035+            'Alert type is Hot Transfer'


1036+        );


1037+        System.Assert.areEqual('Promotion', alerts[0].Priority_Reason__c, 'Priority reason copied');


1038+        System.Assert.areEqual('New', alerts[0].Status__c, 'Alert starts in New');


1039+        System.Assert.areEqual(


1040+            'hot-alert:' + tg.Id,


1041+            alerts[0].External_Id__c,


1042+            'External_Id keyed hot-alert:{groupId}'


1043+        );


1044+    }


1045+


1046+    @isTest


1047+    static void hotTransferToggleIsIdempotent() {


1048+        originWarehouseId = [SELECT Id FROM Location__c WHERE Name = 'Milton FL' LIMIT 1].Id;


1049+        destinationWarehouseId = [


1050+            SELECT Id


1051+            FROM Location__c


1052+            WHERE Name = 'Montgomery AL'


1053+            LIMIT 1


1054+        ]


1055+        .Id;


1056+


1057+        S_TransferAlertNotifier.recipientOverride = new Set<String>();


1058+        Transfer_Group__c tg = (Transfer_Group__c) TestDataFactory.createSObject(


1059+            'Transfer_Group__c',


1060+            new Map<String, Object>{


1061+                'Origin_Location__c' => originWarehouseId,


1062+                'New_Location__c' => destinationWarehouseId,


1063+                'Status__c' => 'In Progress',


1064+                'Is_Picked__c' => true,


1065+                'Is_External__c' => false,


1066+                'Transfer_Date__c' => System.today(),


1067+                'Is_Hot_Transfer__c' => false


1068+            }


1069+        );


1070+


1071+        Test.startTest();


1072+        tg.Is_Hot_Transfer__c = true;


1073+        tg.Hot_Transfer_Priority_Reason__c = 'Emergency Stock';


1074+        update tg;


1075+        // Toggle off and back on — should still be one alert row.


1076+        tg.Is_Hot_Transfer__c = false;


1077+        update tg;


1078+        tg.Is_Hot_Transfer__c = true;


1079+        update tg;


1080+        Test.stopTest();


1081+


1082+        System.Assert.areEqual(


1083+            1,


1084+            [


1085+                SELECT COUNT()


1086+                FROM Transfer_Alert__c


1087+                WHERE Transfer_Group__c = :tg.Id AND Alert_Type__c = 'Hot Transfer'


1088+            ],


1089+            'Toggling hot off+on must not duplicate the alert'


1090+        );


1091+        System.Assert.areEqual(


1092+            1,


1093+            S_TransferAlertNotifier.lastNotifyBatchSize,


1094+            'Notification must fire on re-toggle — External_Id__c re-query must find the row even on the upsert UPDATE leg'


1095+        );


1096+    }


1097 }

docs/product/wms/internal-transfer-alerts/release-notes-snippet.md +28-0 
@@ -0,0 +1,28 @@


1+## Internal Transfer Alerts


2+


3+When a warehouse dispatches an internal transfer, receiving warehouse teams are now automatically alerted to any inbound inventory that is close to its code date or flagged as a hot/priority transfer — so dock staff can prioritise unloading and avoid accepting product they can't sell through.


4+


5+### Close-to-Code alerts


6+


7+When a `Transfer_Group__c` transitions **New → In Progress**, Ohanafy evaluates every transfer line against the receiving warehouse's existing close-to-code thresholds (`CTC_Threshold__mdt`). Lines whose FEFO lot falls inside the receiving warehouse's Critical, Act, or Monitor band generate a `Transfer_Alert__c` record — one per flagged transfer line — carrying the item, lot, quantity, days to code, and urgency band.


8+


9+A platform notification is also sent to all users assigned the **WMS Inbound Transfer Alert Receiver** permission set, so receiving staff are notified in real time on desktop and mobile.


10+


11+### Hot Transfer flag


12+


13+Dispatch managers can mark any `Transfer_Group__c` as a hot/priority transfer by toggling **Is Hot Transfer** on the Transfer Group record and selecting a priority reason (Promotion, Emergency Stock, Customer Commitment, or Other). A `Transfer_Alert__c` of type `Hot Transfer` is immediately created for the receiving warehouse and a platform notification is dispatched.


14+


15+### Acknowledgment


16+


17+Each alert has an **Acknowledge** button visible to receiving staff. Acknowledging stamps the alert with the acknowledging user's name and timestamp and changes its status from New to Acknowledged. The banner and queue continue to show recently-acknowledged alerts (last 48 hours) so supervisors retain context.


18+


19+### New UI surfaces


20+


21+**Transfer Group record page — Alert Banner:** A new `transferAlertBanner` component appears in the header of every Transfer Group record page. It shows:


22+


23+- Hot Transfer alert in a danger-colored banner with the priority reason.


24+- Close-to-Code alerts with type and urgency-band pills, item name, days to code, case quantity, and lot number.


25+- A "Partial — X of Y items flagged" label when only some of the transfer's line items are close to code.


26+- Per-alert Acknowledge button; acknowledged state shows who acknowledged and when.


27+


28+**Warehouse Layout home page — Inbound Alert Queue:** A new `transferAlertQueue` component on the Warehouse Layout app page shows all inbound alerts for a configured warehouse location. Alerts sort hot-first, then by urgency band (Critical → Act → Monitor), then by detection time. Alerts open longer than 4 hours without acknowledgment show an **Overdue** badge.

1+# Internal Transfer Alerts — Setup


2+


3+## What it does


4+


5+Internal Transfer Alerts notify receiving warehouse staff whenever an inbound transfer carries close-to-code or hot-priority inventory. Setup involves two steps: assigning the receiving-staff permission set, and configuring the warehouse queue component on the Warehouse Layout app page.


6+


7+## Setup


8+


9+### 1. Assign the receiving-staff permission set


10+


11+Users who should receive platform notifications and appear in the alert queue must be assigned the **WMS Inbound Transfer Alert Receiver** permission set.


12+


13+In Setup → Permission Sets → **WMS Inbound Transfer Alert Receiver** → Manage Assignments → Add Assignments, select every user in a receiving role (dock supervisors, warehouse managers, inventory coordinators).


14+


15+Users without this assignment will not receive platform notifications and will not be resolved as recipients for new alerts. The banner on the Transfer Group record page is visible to anyone with object-level access to `Transfer_Alert__c` regardless of this permission set.


16+


17+### 2. Add the Alert Queue to the Warehouse Layout app page


18+


19+The `transferAlertQueue` component must be placed on the **Warehouse Layout** app page and configured with the warehouse's Location record ID.


20+


21+1. Open **App Builder** for the Warehouse Layout page (Setup → Lightning App Builder → Warehouse Layout → Edit).


22+2. Drag the **Transfer Alert Queue** component to the desired region (recommended: above the warehouse visualization).


23+3. In the component's property panel, set **Location Id** to the Salesforce record ID of the `Location__c` record that represents the warehouse (the same record used as `Receiving_Location__c` on inbound transfers).


24+4. Save and activate.


25+


26+Repeat for each warehouse that should have its own queue view. If multiple warehouses share one app page (tabbed layout), place one `transferAlertQueue` component per tab, each configured with its own location ID.


27+


28+### 3. (Optional) Configure close-to-code thresholds


29+


30+Close-to-Code alerts use the receiving warehouse's existing `CTC_Threshold__mdt` rows — the same configuration that drives the CTC Suggestion Engine. If a warehouse has no threshold rows, no CTC alerts will fire for inbound transfers to that warehouse. See [CTC Suggestion Engine setup](../ctc-suggestion-engine/) for threshold configuration.


31+


32+## Limitations


33+


34+- Only transfer lines with a tracked, sellable lot at the origin location generate CTC alerts. Items without lot tracking or with no qualifying on-hand lot produce no alert.


35+- Hot Transfer alerts are created immediately when `Is Hot Transfer` is toggled on. Toggling the flag off does not retract the existing alert; it remains visible (with Acknowledged status) in the queue for 48 hours.


36+- The Overdue badge threshold (4 hours) is fixed in the v1 release. Per-warehouse escalation hours are planned for a future iteration.

1+# Internal Transfer Alerts — Usage


2+


3+## What it does


4+


5+Receiving warehouse staff see alerts on two surfaces: the Transfer Group record page (for drill-in review of a specific transfer) and the Warehouse Layout home page (for a real-time queue of all pending inbound alerts across the warehouse).


6+


7+## Transfer Group record page — Alert Banner


8+


9+When you open a Transfer Group that has been dispatched (status In Progress), the **transferAlertBanner** component appears at the top of the page if any alerts exist.


10+


11+### Reading the banner


12+


13+Each alert row shows:


14+


15+| Element                            | Meaning                                                                                                                              |


16+| ---------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |


17+| **HOT TRANSFER** pill (red)        | Transfer was flagged as hot/priority by the sending manager                                                                          |


18+| **CTC** pill (orange/red)          | One or more transfer lines are close to code                                                                                         |


19+| Urgency band pill                  | **Critical** / **Act** / **Monitor** — severity against the receiving warehouse's threshold                                          |


20+| Item name                          | The SKU flagged on that transfer line                                                                                                |


21+| Days to code                       | Calendar days remaining before the lot's code date                                                                                   |


22+| Cases                              | Quantity on that transfer line                                                                                                       |


23+| Priority Reason                    | Shown on Hot Transfer alerts (e.g. "Promotion", "Emergency Stock")                                                                   |


24+| **Partial — X of Y items flagged** | Only some of the transfer's line items are close to code; X is the CTC-flagged item count, Y is the total item count on the transfer |


25+


26+### Acknowledging an alert


27+


28+Click **Acknowledge** on any alert row to mark it as reviewed. The button is replaced with "Acknowledged by [Your Name] at [time]". Acknowledgment does not block receiving or change any inventory — it is a coordination signal for supervisors monitoring the queue.


29+


30+## Warehouse Layout home page — Inbound Alert Queue


31+


32+The **transferAlertQueue** component shows all pending (New) and recently-acknowledged (last 48 hours) alerts for the configured warehouse location.


33+


34+### Sort order


35+


36+Alerts sort in this priority:


37+


38+1. Hot Transfer alerts first


39+2. Close-to-Code by urgency: Critical → Act → Monitor


40+3. Within each group: oldest detection time first


41+


42+### Overdue badge


43+


44+Any New (unacknowledged) alert older than 4 hours shows an **Overdue** badge in orange. This signals that the transfer may have already arrived at the dock and the alert has not been reviewed.


45+


46+### Acknowledging from the queue


47+


48+Each alert row has an **Acknowledge** button. Clicking it marks the alert as acknowledged and refreshes the queue immediately. Acknowledged alerts remain visible in a grayed-out state for 48 hours, then drop off the queue.


49+


50+## Platform notifications


51+


52+Users assigned the **WMS Inbound Transfer Alert Receiver** permission set receive a platform notification (bell icon + mobile push if enabled) each time a new alert is created. The notification links directly to the `Transfer_Alert__c` record. Notifications are sent per-alert at the time the alert is created, not batched.


53+


54+## Flagging a Hot Transfer (sending manager)


55+


56+On any Transfer Group record in Draft or In Progress status, toggle **Is Hot Transfer** to `true` and select a **Priority Reason**. An optional **Hot Transfer Notes** field is available for additional context. The alert is created and notifications are sent immediately on save; the receiving warehouse queue updates in real time.

1+// @covers OHFY-WMS-UI/lwc/transferAlertBanner


2+// @covers OHFY-WMS-UI/lwc/transferAlertQueue


3+import { test, expect } from "../../fixtures/salesforce.fixture";


4+import { runSfApex, runSfQuery, extractDebugPayload } from "../../support/sfCli";


5+


6+const ORG = process.env.SF_ORG_ALIAS ?? "ohfy-dev";


7+


8+/**


9+ * Seeds two locations, two Transfer__c line items, one Transfer Group, and three


10+ * Transfer_Alert__c records:


11+ *   - ctcAlert  (Close to Code / Critical / New, linked to item 1)  — render + partial-label test


12+ *   - hotAlert  (Hot Transfer / New)                                 — hot-transfer render test


13+ *   - ackAlert  (Close to Code / Act / New)                          — dedicated acknowledge test


14+ *


15+ * Two Transfer__c lines ensure getTransferLineCount() = 2 so ctcItemCount (1) < total (2),


16+ * which makes showPartialLabel = true for the AC4 assertion.


17+ *


18+ * Seeded once at module-load (synchronous runSfApex) so the org is stable for all tests.


19+ */


20+const SEED_SCRIPT = `


21+List<Item__c> items = [SELECT Id FROM Item__c WHERE Type__c = 'Finished Good' LIMIT 2];


22+


23+Location__c origin = new Location__c(


24+    Name  = 'PW Transfer Origin',


25+    Location_Code__c = 'PWTO',


26+    Is_Active__c = true,


27+    Type__c = 'Warehouse'


28+);


29+Location__c dest = new Location__c(


30+    Name  = 'PW Transfer Dest',


31+    Location_Code__c = 'PWTD',


32+    Is_Active__c = true,


33+    Type__c = 'Warehouse'


34+);


35+insert new List<Location__c>{ origin, dest };


36+


37+Transfer_Group__c grp = new Transfer_Group__c(


38+    Origin_Location__c  = origin.Id,


39+    New_Location__c     = dest.Id,


40+    Status__c           = 'New',


41+    Is_Picked__c        = true,


42+    Is_External__c      = false,


43+    Transfer_Date__c    = Date.today()


44+);


45+insert grp;


46+


47+// Two line items: only item 1 gets a CTC alert, item 2 does not.


48+// This makes getTransferLineCount()=2 and ctcItemCount=1 → showPartialLabel=true (AC4).


49+Transfer__c line1 = new Transfer__c(


50+    Item__c                 = items[0].Id,


51+    Origin_Location__c      = origin.Id,


52+    New_Location__c         = dest.Id,


53+    Transfer_Quantity_Cases__c = 5,


54+    Transfer_Date__c        = Date.today(),


55+    Transfer_Group__c       = grp.Id,


56+    Is_Sellable__c          = true


57+);


58+Transfer__c line2 = new Transfer__c(


59+    Item__c                 = items[1].Id,


60+    Origin_Location__c      = origin.Id,


61+    New_Location__c         = dest.Id,


62+    Transfer_Quantity_Cases__c = 3,


63+    Transfer_Date__c        = Date.today(),


64+    Transfer_Group__c       = grp.Id,


65+    Is_Sellable__c          = true


66+);


67+insert new List<Transfer__c>{ line1, line2 };


68+


69+Transfer_Alert__c ctcAlert = new Transfer_Alert__c(


70+    Transfer_Group__c   = grp.Id,


71+    Receiving_Location__c = dest.Id,


72+    Origin_Location__c  = origin.Id,


73+    Alert_Type__c       = 'Close to Code',


74+    Urgency_Band__c     = 'Critical',


75+    Status__c           = 'New',


76+    Days_To_Code__c     = 3,


77+    Case_Quantity__c    = 10,


78+    Item__c             = items[0].Id,


79+    Detected_At__c      = Datetime.now(),


80+    External_Id__c      = 'pw-ctc-' + String.valueOf(Datetime.now().getTime())


81+);


82+Transfer_Alert__c hotAlert = new Transfer_Alert__c(


83+    Transfer_Group__c   = grp.Id,


84+    Receiving_Location__c = dest.Id,


85+    Origin_Location__c  = origin.Id,


86+    Alert_Type__c       = 'Hot Transfer',


87+    Status__c           = 'New',


88+    Priority_Reason__c  = 'Promotion',


89+    Case_Quantity__c    = 6,


90+    Detected_At__c      = Datetime.now(),


91+    External_Id__c      = 'pw-hot-' + String.valueOf(Datetime.now().getTime())


92+);


93+Transfer_Alert__c ackAlert = new Transfer_Alert__c(


94+    Transfer_Group__c   = grp.Id,


95+    Receiving_Location__c = dest.Id,


96+    Origin_Location__c  = origin.Id,


97+    Alert_Type__c       = 'Close to Code',


98+    Urgency_Band__c     = 'Act',


99+    Status__c           = 'New',


100+    Days_To_Code__c     = 7,


101+    Case_Quantity__c    = 4,


102+    Priority_Reason__c  = 'Playwright Ack Test',


103+    Detected_At__c      = Datetime.now(),


104+    External_Id__c      = 'pw-ack-' + String.valueOf(Datetime.now().getTime())


105+);


106+insert new List<Transfer_Alert__c>{ ctcAlert, hotAlert, ackAlert };


107+


108+System.debug('TAALERT_SEED::' + JSON.serialize(new Map<String, String>{


109+    'groupId'    => grp.Id,


110+    'ctcAlertId' => ctcAlert.Id,


111+    'hotAlertId' => hotAlert.Id,


112+    'ackAlertId' => ackAlert.Id,


113+    'receivingId' => dest.Id


114+}));


115+`;


116+


117+interface TransferAlertSeed {


118+    groupId: string;


119+    ctcAlertId: string;


120+    hotAlertId: string;


121+    ackAlertId: string;


122+    receivingId: string;


123+}


124+


125+let seed: TransferAlertSeed | null = null;


126+try {


127+    const seedLog = runSfApex(SEED_SCRIPT, ORG);


128+    seed = extractDebugPayload<TransferAlertSeed>(seedLog, "TAALERT_SEED");


129+} catch {


130+    // Transfer_Alert__c not deployed to this org — all tests will skip via !GROUP_ID guard


131+}


132+const GROUP_ID = seed?.groupId;


133+


134+// ─── transferAlertBanner — on Transfer_Group__c record page ──────────────────


135+


136+test.describe("Transfer Alert Banner — BMS-3768", () => {


137+    test.skip(!GROUP_ID, "Transfer Alert seed failed — ensure WMS packages are deployed and org is connected");


138+


139+    test.beforeEach(async ({ sfPage }) => {


140+        await sfPage.goToRecord(GROUP_ID!);


141+        // Wait until the wire result resolves (loading skeleton → alert rows)


142+        await expect(sfPage.getByTestId("tab-alert-row").first()).toBeVisible({ timeout: 30_000 });


143+    });


144+


145+    test("renders CTC alert with urgency band and days-to-code label (AC1)", async ({


146+        sfPage


147+    }) => {


148+        const ctcRow = sfPage.getByTestId("tab-alert-row").filter({ hasText: "Close to Code" }).first();


149+        await expect(ctcRow).toBeVisible({ timeout: 10_000 });


150+        await expect(ctcRow).toContainText("Critical");


151+        await expect(ctcRow).toContainText("3 day(s) to code");


152+        await expect(ctcRow).toContainText("10 cases");


153+    });


154+


155+    test("renders Hot Transfer alert with red type pill and priority reason (AC2)", async ({


156+        sfPage


157+    }) => {


158+        const hotRow = sfPage


159+            .getByTestId("tab-alert-row")


160+            .filter({ hasText: "Hot Transfer" })


161+            .first();


162+        await expect(hotRow).toBeVisible({ timeout: 10_000 });


163+        await expect(hotRow).toContainText("Promotion");


164+        // Urgency band should NOT appear on Hot Transfer rows


165+        await expect(hotRow).not.toContainText("Critical");


166+        await expect(hotRow).not.toContainText("Act");


167+    });


168+


169+    test("shows Partial label when only some transfer line items are CTC-flagged (AC4)", async ({


170+        sfPage


171+    }) => {


172+        // Seed: 2 Transfer__c lines, 1 CTC alert → totalTransferLineCount=2, ctcItemCount=1 → Partial


173+        await expect(sfPage.getByTestId("tab-partial-label")).toBeVisible({ timeout: 10_000 });


174+        await expect(sfPage.getByTestId("tab-partial-label")).toContainText("Partial");


175+        await expect(sfPage.getByTestId("tab-partial-label")).toContainText("1 of 2");


176+    });


177+


178+    test("Acknowledge button marks alert Acknowledged in UI and backend (AC3)", async ({


179+        sfPage


180+    }) => {


181+        // Target the dedicated ack-test row (unique priority reason)


182+        const ackRow = sfPage


183+            .getByTestId("tab-alert-row")


184+            .filter({ hasText: "Playwright Ack Test" })


185+            .first();


186+        const ackBtn = ackRow.getByTestId("tab-ack-btn");


187+        await expect(ackBtn).toBeVisible({ timeout: 10_000 });


188+        await ackBtn.click();


189+        // UI: badge replaces button


190+        await expect(ackRow.getByTestId("tab-acked-badge")).toBeVisible({ timeout: 15_000 });


191+        await expect(ackRow.getByTestId("tab-acked-badge")).toContainText("Acknowledged");


192+        // Backend: SOQL confirms status


193+        await expect(async () => {


194+            const rows = runSfQuery(


195+                `SELECT ohfy__Status__c FROM ohfy__Transfer_Alert__c WHERE Id = '${seed!.ackAlertId}'`,


196+                ORG


197+            );


198+            expect(rows[0]?.ohfy__Status__c).toBe("Acknowledged");


199+        }).toPass({ timeout: 15_000, intervals: [2_000, 3_000, 5_000] });


200+    });


201+});


202+


203+// ─── transferAlertQueue — FlexiPage/tab deployment pending ───────────────────


204+//


205+// transferAlertQueue renders via @api locationId (FlexiPage design attribute).


206+// A dedicated tab + AppPage (similar to Warehouse_Layout) needs to be added


207+// to org-metadata before this component can be reached by Playwright.


208+//


209+// Sort-order (Hot > Critical > Act > Monitor), overdue-badge (>4h), and


210+// acknowledge-reload logic are fully covered by:


211+//   OHFY-WMS-UI/lwc/transferAlertQueue/__tests__/transferAlertQueue.test.js


212+//


213+test.describe("Transfer Alert Queue — BMS-3768", () => {


214+    test.skip(true, "transferAlertQueue requires a Lightning App Page tab deployment to be E2E-testable. Logic is covered by Jest (transferAlertQueue.test.js).");


215+


216+    test("placeholder — queue renders with Hot Transfer sorted above CTC", () => {});


217+});
